set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- A downstream adapter describes construction, reading, views, copying, mutation, reductions, casting, and interop without private Ravel access.
- Generators cover ranks zero through six, empty and singleton axes, canonical and noncanonical layouts, all dtypes, owned and borrowed provenance, floating edge values, arithmetic boundaries, and invalid inputs.
- Shrinking preserves valid shape-layout relationships and reports replayable seeds.
- RuleSets cover shape, view composition, traversal, alias isolation, broadcasting, reduction schedules, dtype casting, mutable locality, and interop.
- Properties depend on generated cases rather than constant Props.
set.title: Design adapter-driven generated Ravel conformance laws
